title: Orca Encounters
text:
Introduction
Orcas are nasty fish that enjoy munching on people! Nope! There are several things that are wrong with that picture. Orcas are cetaceans related to dolphins that live in all of the world oceans. They are higly intelligent predators that hunt in coordinated family pods using very elaborate strategies. Their varied diet includes fish, sharks, smaller marine mammals (e.g. see lions), and even whales.

title: Palm Trees of the World
text:
Introduction
Palm trees are quite variable in height ranging from 0 to 170 meters.









Palm tress can be grouped by Tribes (a taxonomic rank between family and genus). Members of some tribes are taller than others. The tibble below shows the top and the bottom 5 tribes according to mean height.
